# Proabono

ProAbono is the smart subscription management software that automates your daily routine.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/proabono/.

## Actions

- **Create Customer**: Create or declare a customer in ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **Delete Subscription Discount**: Delete a subscription discount via the Backoffice API.
- **Get Customer Billing Address** (read-only): Retrieve a customer's billing address via the Backoffice API.
- **Get Customer by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a single customer by ID from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **Get Customer by Reference** (read-only): Retrieve a customer by their reference identifier from ProAbono API.
- **Get Customer Payment Settings** (read-only): Retrieve customer payment settings via the Backoffice API.
- **Get Invoice** (read-only): Retrieve a specific invoice or credit note by ID from ProAbono.
- **Get Offer by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a single offer by its ID from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **Get Subscription by Customer Reference** (read-only): Retrieve a subscription by customer reference from ProAbono.
- **List Customers** (read-only): List all customers from ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **List Features** (read-only): List all features via the ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Invoices and Credit Notes** (read-only): List all invoices and credit notes from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Offers** (read-only): List all subscription offers (plans) from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Payments** (read-only): List all payments from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Subscriptions** (read-only): List all subscriptions from ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **Update Customer**: Update an existing customer in ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **Update Customer Payment Settings**: Update payment settings for a specific customer in ProAbono.
- **Anonymize Customer**: Anonymize a customer for GDPR compliance.
- **Bill Customer**: Trigger billing for a customer.
- **Create Feature**: Create a new feature in ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a customer from ProAbono by ID.
- **Delete Offer**: Delete an offer from ProAbono by ID.
- **Delete Pricing Table**: Delete a pricing table from ProAbono by its ID.
- **Delete Pricing Table Offer**: Delete a pricing table offer via the ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **Enable Webhook**: Enable a webhook in ProAbono via the Notification API.
- **Get Customer Billing Address by Reference** (read-only): Retrieve the billing address for a customer by reference from ProAbono API.
- **Get Discount** (read-only): Retrieve a discount by ID via the Backoffice API.
- **Get Feature by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a feature by ID from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **Get Feature by Reference** (read-only): Retrieve a single feature by its reference from ProAbono API.
- **Get Subscription Creation Quote** (read-only): Get a pricing quote for creating a new subscription without actually creating it.
- **Get Usage Record** (read-only): Retrieve a single usage record for a specific feature and customer combination from ProAbono.
- **Get Usages for Customer** (read-only): Retrieve usage data for customers from ProAbono.
- **Invalidate Customer**: Invalidate a customer by their reference.
- **Invalidate Customer by ID**: Invalidate a customer by their ProAbono internal ID.
- **List Balance Lines** (read-only): List all balance lines from ProAbono.
- **List Business Localization** (read-only): List localization entries by business from ProAbono via the HostedPages API.
- **List Businesses** (read-only): List all businesses from ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **List Customer Moves** (read-only): List all customer balance moves via the ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Customers by Feature** (read-only): List customers that have access to a specific feature via the ProAbono API.
- **List Discounts** (read-only): List all discounts from ProAbono's Backoffice API.
- **List Features (V1)** (read-only): Retrieve all features from ProAbono API using the /v1/Features endpoint.
- **List Gateway Accounts** (read-only): List payment gateway accounts from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Gateway Permissions** (read-only): List gateway permissions from ProAbono API.
- **List Gateway Requests** (read-only): List gateway requests from ProAbono.
- **List Gateway Transactions** (read-only): List gateway transactions from ProAbono.
- **List Invoice Lines** (read-only): List all invoice lines from ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **List Invoices by Customer Reference** (read-only): List invoices for a specific customer by their reference identifier from ProAbono API.
- **List Pricing Table Offers** (read-only): List all pricing table offers via the ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Pricing Tables** (read-only): List all pricing tables from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Segment Localizations** (read-only): List localization entries by segment from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Segments** (read-only): List all segments from ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **List Subscription Discounts** (read-only): List all subscription discounts via the ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Subscription Features** (read-only): List all subscription features via the ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Subscription Periods** (read-only): List all subscription periods (billing cycles) from ProAbono Backoffice API.
- **List Subscriptions (V1)** (read-only): Retrieve all subscriptions from ProAbono API using the /v1/Subscriptions endpoint.
- **List Tax Profile Exceptions** (read-only): List tax profile exceptions from ProAbono Organization API.
- **List Tax Profiles** (read-only): List all tax profiles from ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **List Upgrade Offers** (read-only): Retrieve offers available to upgrade an existing customer subscription.
- **List Webhook Notifications** (read-only): List webhook notifications from ProAbono via the Notification API.
- **List Webhooks** (read-only): List webhooks from ProAbono Notification API.
- **Quote Balance Line Creation** (read-only): Get a pricing quote for creating a balance line (one-time charge or credit).
- **Revoke Customer Portal Links**: Revoke encrypted customer portal links and generate new ones in ProAbono.
- **Update Business Billing Address**: Update business billing address via the Backoffice API.
- **Update Customer Billing Address**: Update the billing address for a customer in ProAbono via the API.
- **Update Customer Shipping Address**: Update customer shipping address via the Backoffice API.
- **Update Feature**: Update an existing feature in ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
- **Update Tax Profiles**: Update an existing tax profile in ProAbono via the Backoffice API.
